entries.contribution:
Ray took all 12 bags of cacao nibs which I assembled a few days ago from the loose cacao nibs I have with me for a total of $120. 

One bag per month, enough to last for an entire year, that was what she said

I guess *_AGL2 is completely sold out*_ at this point (_we only had 5 bags remaining on the ledger when I left Switzerland_). I will tabulate, then issue out the accrued revenue to various various AGL2 investors before closing it out over the next few days

Meanwhile 7 bags from our own vault were sold as well. 

I gifted 1 bottles of cacao molasses from AGL6 to her

Ray will probably be going about reselling some of her supplies in this part of the desert over the next few months as she is a vendor

Angela and Jim will be returning to USA and hanging out near Cibola hippie hole by the Colorado river in March. 

She mentioned she would like some delivered over to her

She and Jim does vending as well. Not sure if they are planning to do so this season. But they do work at La Pines resort in Oregon. It might make sense to pop by the resort when they are there and then see if I could drop off a few bags 

Meanwhile there is Johnny who is vending in southern Oregon 

Jennifer who is vending out of her bus in Eugene 

And then Elinor and Levi up north in Washington which mentioned they would be keen to carry and sell these out of their bus before we parted ways last year 

Mmaisy also mentioned she is out of supplies and needs some to make more of her recipe which she sold out during the autumn hippie festival 

Finally not forgetting Sangara and Willow Star the two shamans based in Mount Shasta 

Guess the decentralized network along the pacific west is growing after all… 

I just didn’t realized it was going to be mainly nomads, shamans and mystics doing the distribution 😊🙏

narrative.text: Levi contributed to the DAO over the period from May 17, 2025, to June 14, 2025, with two contributions in the 20250617_beerhall project. These included injecting liquidity, earning 1 TDG for every 1 USD provided, and one hour of human effort, earning 100 TDG per hour.
